title: L-TAP (Leisure Time Activity Programme)
summary: Music, dance, art, language and skills courses at ₹1,500 each.

posts.md:
The **Leisure Time Activity Program (L-TAP)** is an initiative by **IIT Madras** that offers training in **extra-curricular activities** and **life skills**.

L-TAP is based on the belief that mental well-being is an essential part of overall health. By encouraging students to participate in recreational and creative activities, the programme helps them:

- Manage stress
- Improve overall well-being
- Channel their energy into learning and personal growth
- Develop new skills beyond academics

## Course Fee

L-TAP offers extra-curricular and soft skills courses every semester at a **nominal fee of ₹1,500 per course**.

These classes are designed to provide students with a rewarding and enriching learning experience.

## Courses Offered

The courses offered may vary each semester. Some of the available courses include:

- Flute
- Guitar
- Hapkido
- Kathak
- Tamil
- Violin
- Yoga
- Bharatanatyam
- Carnatic Music
- Crafts & Clay Modelling
- Effective English Communication
- Mridangam
- Single-Shade Painting / Sketching
- Soft Skills
- Web & Mobile Application Development
